source_facts: Installed child profile unpriv_bwrap explicitly audit-denies all capabilities despite visible cap bits.
Current author helper own label bwrap//&unpriv_bwrap(enforce), not asserted as measured failed child label.

bwrap original source creates network in first userns; second userns only if UID/GID mapping differs/devpts or disable-userns. Current wrapper uid/gid0,no devpts,no disable-userns, so parent-owner mismatch not source-expected.
Root-only diagnostic checks actual net owning userns ioctl plus current label and cap/maps without assigning any addresses.
Inline ioctl/netlink would face same LSM capability deny; no bypass/profile/sysctl change proposed.
